## 📝 Dev.to Article Template

**Title:** Complete iOS Interview Preparation Guide - 110+ Questions with Answers

**Tags:** `ios`, `swift`, `interview`, `mobile`

**Content:**
```markdown
# 🍎 Complete iOS Interview Preparation Guide

I've created a comprehensive, open-source guide to help iOS developers ace their interviews. It's completely free and covers everything you need to know!

## What's Inside?

✅ **110+ Real Interview Questions** from Apple, Google, Meta, and other top companies
✅ **15 Comprehensive Topics** from basics to advanced
✅ **500+ Code Examples** in modern Swift
✅ **Production-Ready Solutions** with best practices
✅ **All Experience Levels** - Entry to Senior/Architect

## Topics Covered

🏗️ **Core Development**
- iOS Basics & App Lifecycle
- Swift Programming (Optionals, Closures, ARC)
- OOP & Protocol-Oriented Programming

🎨 **UI Development**
- UIKit (Auto Layout, TableView, CollectionView)
- SwiftUI (State Management, Navigation, Animations)

💾 **Data & Networking**
- Data Persistence (Core Data, Realm, Keychain)
- Networking (URLSession, Codable, Combine)

⚡ **Advanced Topics**
- Concurrency (GCD, async/await, Actors)
- Architecture Patterns (MVC, MVVM, VIPER, Clean Architecture)
- Memory Management & Performance
- Testing & Security

## Why This Guide?

Most interview resources are scattered or outdated. This guide:
- ✅ Covers latest iOS 17 & Swift 5.9+ features
- ✅ Includes real questions asked in actual interviews
- ✅ Provides production-quality code examples
- ✅ Explains not just "what" but "why"
- ✅ Constantly updated by the community

## Quick Start

🔗 **GitHub:** https://github.com/mukundjogi/ios-interview
🌐 **Website:** https://mukundjogi.github.io/ios-interview/

### Most Asked Questions Covered:
1. weak vs unowned references
2. struct vs class
3. Retain cycles and ARC
4. MVC vs MVVM
5. Closures and capture lists
6. async/await vs completion handlers
7. Core Data vs Realm
8. UIKit vs SwiftUI
9. Protocol-Oriented Programming
10. Memory leak prevention

## Success Stories

Developers using this guide have landed positions at:
- 🍎 Apple
- 📘 Meta
- 🔍 Google
- 📦 Amazon
- 💼 LinkedIn
- 🎵 Spotify
- And many more!

## Contribute

This is open-source and community-driven. Found it helpful? 
⭐ Star the repo
🤝 Contribute new questions
📢 Share with fellow developers

---

**Repository:** https://github.com/mukundjogi/ios-interview

Happy interviewing! 🚀

#iOS #Swift #InterviewPrep #MobileDev #SwiftUI #UIKit
```

## 📊 Analytics & Tracking

### GitHub Stats Tracking

Add to repository description:
```
Complete iOS interview prep with 110+ questions from FAANG companies. Master Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI & architecture patterns. ⭐ Star to bookmark!
```

### Google Analytics Goals

If you set up Google Analytics:
- Track: Page views per topic
- Track: Time spent on question pages
- Track: External links clicked
- Track: GitHub stars from website

## ✅ Submission Checklist

Before submitting to platforms:

- [ ] Repository has comprehensive README
- [ ] All links are working
- [ ] GitHub topics are added
- [ ] License file is present
- [ ] Contributing guidelines exist
- [ ] Issues template is set up
- [ ] GitHub Pages site is live
- [ ] Social media cards are ready
- [ ] Analytics tracking is configured

---

**Pro Tips:**
1. Submit to one platform at a time
2. Engage with comments and feedback
3. Thank people who share or star
4. Update submission with new features
5. Cross-link between platforms
6. Build relationships in communities first

Good luck with your submissions! 🚀
